what: a circular pattern (6 copies about Y) of a through hole and the 1 mm chamfer on its rim (the report: the pattern is refused because the copied chamfer 'would grow the part'); rebuilt as a hole in a disc, the original design is not in the report
method: Disc R=30, h=10 (axis Y): V0 = pi 900 10 = 28274.3339. Each hole: diameter 4 through (pi 4 10 = 125.6637) plus the 1 mm chamfer on the top rim, a frustum from r=2 (depth 1) to r=3 (top) minus the cylinder it overlaps: pi/3 (4 + 6 + 9) - 4 pi = 7 pi/3 = 7.3304. The holes sit on a circle of radius 20, 60 degrees apart (chord 20, holes 4 mm wide plus the chamfer's 6 mm: no overlap, and 20 - 3 > 0 leaves the rim inside the disc). V = V0 - 6 (125.6637 + 7.3304) = 27476.3693 mm3. Faces: side, top, bottom, plus a wall and a cone per hole = 15.
